sophiab: Quick sanity check — I ran a cross-region microbench (seq=50, batch=1) for Llama-70B, Mistral-7B-v0, and Qwen-36B quant4 on H100/A100/MI300 across eu-west1 / us-central1 / ap-southeast1. Dropping raw numbers and notes here; curious about kernel fallthroughs, GQA vs ROPE, and ctx-length effects.

bench-bot: run summary: job=bench/1900003333 created at 2025-03-10T11:22:00Z. Args: --seq 50 --batch 1 --prefer-kernel=auto --quant=4a --traces=on :robot_face:

sophiab: TL;DR: Mistral wins median on H100, Qwen benefits from ROPE-specific kernel on MI300, Llama shows p95 spikes on A100 when GQA is enabled.

omar_r: paste the numbers?

sophiab: raw CSV below (p50/p95 in ms, throughput reqs/s):

```
model,gpu,region,kernel,p50_ms,p95_ms,throughput
Mistral-7B,H100,eu-west1,auto,18,72,45
Qwen-36B,MI300,ap-southeast1,auto,34,140,22
Qwen-36B,MI300,ap-southeast1,rope,30,118,25
Llama-70B,A100,us-central1,auto,45,210,12
Llama-70B,A100,us-central1,gqa,40,320,13
Mistral-7B,A100,us-central1,auto,25,95,38
```

liwei: observed Qwen on MI300 did a kernel fallback around step ~120 — log snippet: `kernel_fallback: reason=kv_cache_stride_mismatch, fallback=generic_attention` — probably ROPE length mismatch with optimized kernel.

marta-s: did you try forcing gqa vs rope for Qwen?

sophiab: yes. Forced `--kernel=rope` vs `--kernel=gqa` manually. For Qwen on MI300: rope ~10-12% faster throughput and lower p95. On A100 the optimized gqa path slightly outperforms rope for the same model. So kernel preference is hardware+model dependent.

liwei: any quality diffs with quant4a? did you run regen or LLR checks?

sophiab: ran quick quality sweep on eval-set-2025-01 (long-context subset). Notes: Qwen-36B quant4a shows small coherence degradation for prompts >4k tokens (probability drift on tail tokens). Llama-70B quant4 shows larger soft-token shifts when toggling GQA (some beam/temperature sensitivity). Will run full ngram/regression later.

omar_r: can you upload perf traces + kernel selection logs? Need to check flamegraphs and whether batching caused KV stride changes.

sophiab: uploaded traces + heatmaps: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/1900003333/perf — key snippet: `kernel=rope, seq_range=1-512, p50=28ms, p95=98ms` and `kernel_fallback events: 14` in MI300 runs.

bench-bot: autoscaler alert — reserved capacity increased in eu-west1 at 11:32 due to queue growth (canary jobs started) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

marta-s: Next steps (short):
- add kernel override matrix for Qwen/MI300 to CI (force rope/gqa to validate)
- run quant4a regen on long-context prompts (>=8k) and diff token probs vs fp16 baseline
- rerun with prefix/KV caching enabled to see impact on p95

sophiab: scheduling canary: job=canary-1900003333-qwen-mi300-rope-override, assigning @liwei and @omar_r. Notes in job: `force-kernel=rope, collect-traces, eval-regens=on`.

liwei: ack — I'll diff token-level probs and send a small report.
omar_r: ack — will triage any token collapse signals. Ping me if p95 > 300ms or fallback count > 10. :thumbsup:
